hero.summary: Middle Frontend Engineer — fintech interfaces by day, open-source side projects by night. I build banking and exchange frontends for outsourcing clients, and personal full-stack apps — a CO₂e tracker, a privacy vault, and a visa guide — with a focus on TypeScript and UX.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I build interfaces. With a Master's in Instrumentation Engineering and a Bachelor's in IT, I see every screen as an instrument: it should reflect what's actually going on — and get out of the user's way.
about.p2: As a Middle Frontend Engineer at an outsourcing fintech company, I develop frontend for banking and stock exchange products. I implement pixel-accurate UI from approved mockups, integrate backends via REST API, stream real-time market data over WebSocket, and build electronic signing flows for banking documents. The stack includes React, TypeScript, Redux, Module Federation 5, Vitest, and Playwright.
about.p3: Outside work I build open-source side projects: EcoTrackr (PWA to log activities and estimate CO₂e — Gemini, Web Workers, @ecotrackr/co2-calculator on npm), VisaGuide for US visa prep (rule engine, CMS admin, PDF export, bilingual PWA), and Lockbox — a privacy-first vault with zero-identity auth (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, Supabase RLS).
about.p4: Across side projects I've shipped initial-load optimization with code splitting, server-side Gemini AI routes with graceful fallback, analytics dashboards with charts and heatmaps, and multi-step form UX with Zod validation.
